name: appx-agent
description: Monorepo for the appx agent stack: agent-protocol (published contract), agent-server (docker image), agent-client (React UI package).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/agent-protocol && npm run build -w packages/agent-server && npm run build -w packages/agent-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/agent-protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.gen:contract: npm run gen:event-schema -w packages/agent-server && npm run openapi -w packages/agent-server && npm run gen:types -w packages/agent-protocol
